## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, what changes for users, and why. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks actually run in the Linux Dev Container and their results.
Explain any checks you could not run; do not mark unexecuted checks as passing.
See the [development checks](https://github.com/brunofelixns/mealie-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/development.md).

## Review checklist

- [ ] The title follows the repository's Conventional Commit types.
- [ ] Functional changes include behavioral tests.
- [ ] Public contracts and immutable compatibility fixtures are preserved; intentional differences are documented in `docs/migration/differences.md`.
- [ ] Documentation is updated; generated documentation is checked where applicable.
- [ ] Examples and logs contain no credentials, real recipe bodies, personal data, or signed URLs.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe migration needs, changed defaults, side effects, or recovery steps, if any.
Report vulnerabilities through `SECURITY.md` before opening a public PR.
